from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    # The most common color is the background. Recolor a background cell
    # when it is directly between matching non-background cells.
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == background and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c - 1] != background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
